summary: Only 0% of your pages are fully substitutable. Most give a visitor something an answer cannot: a transaction, a tool, data of your own, or a place to go. That is a durable position.
caveat: This is not a traffic forecast. Docket cannot see your analytics and nobody knows how far AI answers will erode any particular site. What it separates is the pages with a reason to be visited from the ones without, which is the decision underneath every mitigation.
